name: Rimegrass Blessing: Cold Vine
description:
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Cryo Dice and 2 Dendro Dice.
After you use a Skill, if the opposing active character is affected by Cryo and Dendro: Remove Cryo from the opposing active character, deal 2 Dendro DMG, draw 1 card, and heal your most injured character for 1 HP. (Twice per Round)
